RULE = "ACTION5 teleports the agent ball back to its home (start-of-level) position"
PARAMS = {"agent": Colour()}

def bind(board, api):
    # the ball is the smallest 'substantial' object (maze/track are larger,
    # the little HUD squares are smaller)
    objs = objects(api.first, api)
    cands = [o for o in objs if o.size >= 16]
    g = min(cands, key=lambda o: o.size).colour if cands else api.background
    return {"agent": g}

def applies(board, act, api, p):
    if act.action != 5:
        return False
    home = find_object(api.first, api, p["agent"])
    if home is None:
        return False
    if find_object(board, api, p["agent"]) is None:
        return False
    y0, y1, x0, x1 = home.box
    objs = objects(api.first, api)
    if not objs:
        return False
    maze = objs[0].colour  # the big maze body
    # only apply when the home box is a clean landing spot (pure maze colour),
    # so the ball will definitely end up exactly as in the first board
    return bool(np.all(board[y0:y1 + 1, x0:x1 + 1] == maze))

def predict(board, act, api, p):
    home = find_object(api.first, api, p["agent"])
    y0, y1, x0, x1 = home.box
    out = board.copy()
    out[y0:y1 + 1, x0:x1 + 1] = api.first[y0:y1 + 1, x0:x1 + 1]
    changed = out[y0:y1 + 1, x0:x1 + 1] != board[y0:y1 + 1, x0:x1 + 1]
    claimed = np.zeros((64, 64), dtype=bool)
    claimed[y0:y1 + 1, x0:x1 + 1] = changed
    return out, claimed

RULE = "clicking an agent-colour tile inside the container shrinks the bottom bar: the rightmost `step` cells of the bar's left colour turn to the right colour"
PARAMS = {"agent": Colour(), "bar_to": Colour(), "step": Int(1, 8)}

def bind(board0, api):
    bg = api.background
    counts = (board0 != bg).sum(axis=1)
    row = int(np.argmax(counts))
    cols = np.where(board0[row] != bg)[0]
    bar_to = int(board0[row, cols[-1]]) if len(cols) else 0
    flat = board0[board0 != bg]
    vals, cnts = np.unique(flat, return_counts=True)
    agent = int(vals[np.argmax(cnts)])
    return {"agent": agent, "bar_to": bar_to, "step": 2}

def _bar_row(board, api):
    bg = api.background
    counts = (board != bg).sum(axis=1)
    row = int(np.argmax(counts))
    cols = np.where(board[row] != bg)[0]
    if len(cols) == 0:
        return None
    return row, cols

def applies(board, act, api, p):
    if act.action != 6 or act.click is None:
        return False
    r, c = act.click
    if not (0 <= r < 64 and 0 <= c < 64) or board[r, c] == api.background:
        return False
    obj = object_at(board, api, (r, c))
    if obj is None or obj.colour != p["agent"]:
        return False
    if not api.layout:
        return False
    cont = api.layout[0]
    if not (cont.y0 <= r <= cont.y1 and cont.x0 <= c <= cont.x1):
        return False
    info = _bar_row(board, api)
    if info is None:
        return False
    row, cols = info
    left_c = board[row, cols[0]]
    if left_c == p["bar_to"]:
        return False
    return int((board[row] == left_c).sum()) >= p["step"]

def predict(board, act, api, p):
    row, cols = _bar_row(board, api)
    left_c = board[row, cols[0]]
    idx = np.where(board[row] == left_c)[0]
    b = int(idx[-1])
    n = min(p["step"], b - int(cols[0]) + 1)
    out = board.copy()
    out[row, b - n + 1:b + 1] = p["bar_to"]
    claimed = np.zeros((64, 64), bool)
    claimed[row, b - n + 1:b + 1] = True
    return out, claimed
